metadata.source: Wikipedia: James Beard Foundation Award decade pages (1990s-2020s)
metadata.notes: jamesbeard.org's awards search is a client-side JavaScript application with no server-rendered records and no discoverable JSON endpoint, so the four Wikipedia decade pages are used as a deterministic secondary source. Only the three narrative-prose lineages are kept; the cookbook, beverage, photography, and lifetime-honor categories are explicitly ignored. Category names are resolved through an alias table, and an unknown Book Awards category name is a hard error. Winners only — the decade pages publish no finalists. Official archive: https://www.jamesbeard.org/awards/media-awards/book-awards
metadata.coverageNotes: The 2021 Book Awards were cancelled because of COVID-19, so 2021 is a genuine gap. Several individual lineage/year combinations are also absent because the Foundation did not run that category that year.
